Container.Name: nod-postgres
Container.Overview:
Nod (1 of 6): PostgreSQL 17 database for Nod, the self-hosted personal AI assistant from the n8n team. Unofficial community packaging, not affiliated with n8n GmbH.
Install order: nod-postgres, nod-runtime, nod-browser-unraid, nod-workspace-network, nod-workspace-unraid, nod-server.
Before installing, create the shared network once in the Unraid terminal: docker network create nod
Choose a database password made of letters and digits only, and enter the same password in nod-server.
Container.Requires: The "nod" Docker network (docker network create nod). Part of the Nod app: install all six nod-* templates.

Config.Name: Database password
Config.Description: Letters and digits only (for example the output of: openssl rand -hex 24). Enter the same value as Database password in nod-server.
